summary: Runs Python callback methods when a watched CHOP channel changes state, changes value, turns on/off, or remains on/off.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable response to the referenced CHOP

key_params.name: executeloc
key_params.note: Choose execution context for callback scripts

key_params.name: fromop
key_params.note: Operator path used when Execute From is Specified Operator

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: CHOP whose channel changes trigger callbacks

key_params.name: channel
key_params.note: Channel pattern that selects triggering channels

key_params.name: offtoon
key_params.note: Run onOffToOn() when the channel switches from off to on

key_params.name: whileon
key_params.note: Run whileOn() while the channel is on

key_params.name: ontooff
key_params.note: Run onOnToOff() when the channel switches from on to off

key_params.name: whileoff
key_params.note: Run whileOff() while the channel is off

key_params.name: valuechange
key_params.note: Run onValueChange() when the channel changes value

key_params.name: freq
key_params.note: Run While On/Off callbacks for every sample or once per frame

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: External callback source file path

key_params.name: syncfile

key_params.name: loadonstart

key_params.name: loadonstartpulse

key_params.name: write

key_params.name: writepulse
key_params.note: Write DAT contents to disk immediately

key_params.name: edit
key_params.note: Open the callback DAT text in an external editor

key_params.name: language
key_params.note: Common DAT script-language selection

key_params.name: extension

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Every-sample execution can run callbacks many times per frame on high-sample-rate CHOPs.
Multiple trigger toggles can call multiple methods from the same channel transition; scripts should stay idempotent.
Execution context changes relative op() lookups, so generated callbacks should use explicit paths or set Execute From carefully.
File sync can overwrite DAT contents from disk or write changes back on save; avoid enabling it accidentally in generated tools.
key_concepts: Runs Python callback functions when watched CHOP channel values change or cross enabled states.
Trigger toggles map to callback methods such as offToOn, whileOn, onToOff, whileOff, and valueChange.
The Frequency parameter controls whether while-on and while-off callbacks run per sample or once per frame.
Callback arguments include the changed channel, sample index, current value, and previous value.
